Repository for various vibe coded experiments.

**Use with caution.** This repository contains experimental code generated by LLMs (including this README). Code may be incomplete, untested, or not follow best practices.

## Quick Start

### SYCL JIT Constants

Run complete build, test, and validation workflow:

```bash
cd sycl-jit-constants
./run-all.sh
```

This automatically:
- Detects available SYCL implementations (Intel oneAPI/AdaptiveCpp)
- Builds with optimization flags
- Runs validation tests
- Verifies compiler optimizations (inlining, constant propagation, dead code elimination)
- Generates detailed reports in `validate-*/` directories

## Usage

Explore at your own risk. Review all code carefully before use.
